answer: Stop sybils with a jade willow thread: an agent bonds one willow grove. Each cycle it hangs one jade bead on a thread; verifiers match the bead's groove to the grove chart, voiding a copied or twice-claimed bead, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 groves at 18x: one bead is carved once for one thread, its groove cut by that willow, unthreadable on a second, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents hang once, keep rights.
